title: Enforce simulator cleanup when closing a plan

nodes.title: Tracer bullet: Run simulator cleanup on the real plan-close commit path
nodes.next: Assign it and start a session
nodes.why: The previous close left 15 project devices. Written instructions did not enforce cleanup.
nodes.cuts: When staging removal of plan/plan.json on main, the existing pre-commit path invokes a cleanup script. Use the committed registry and live inventory even after the registry is cleared in the index. Delete unused project simulators by UDID, re-list, and fail the close on inventory or deletion errors or unexplained leftovers. Protect default devices and devices owned by active work; report retained owners. Preserve the existing human close and guard-file commit rules. Replace the manual AGENTS.md checklist with the actual behavior.
